spec2def(winscard.dll winscard.spec)

# winscard.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/winscard-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(winscard_shims OBJECT winscard.c stubs.c)
target_link_libraries(winscard_shims PRIVATE wine libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(winscard_shims)
add_cargo_module(winscard winscard-cargo winscard.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS winscard_shims psdk)
